posts.text: Ana Milosavljevic in Belgrade Vučić’s concession prompts wild scenes of celebration here in Belgrade. Some are still in disbelief. “This was kind of easy, no?,” they laugh.

posts.title: Ipsos/CeSID projection: Student List wins by landslide, ending Vučić’s rule
posts.text: We are just getting the first Ipsos/CeSID projection, which shows the Student List well ahead on 52%, with Vučić’s list on mere 39.3%. They are projected to have 138 seats in the new parliament, well clear of the 126 required for majority, to Vučić’s 104. That’s via the N1 broadcaster.

posts.title: Vučić concedes election, says Student List will be the largest party
posts.text: Did you have that on your bingo? Vučić appears to concede the election. He says he is expecting the Student List to have a majority in the new parliament, well clear of the 126 required to govern, and his SNS will have only 105 mandates. Wow. What a moment.
